 Everton’s opponents for the quarter-finals of the Carabao Cup have been confirmed.   
 The Blues will face Fleetwood Town after David Moyes’ side earned a 3-1 victory over Newcastle United in the fourth round on Thursday evening.   
 The fixture date, kick-off time and ticket details of the last-eight tie will be confirmed on Everton Club channels in due course.   
 The Fishermen – managed by Matt Lawlor – earned a famous victory over Arsenal earlier this week, knocking out the reigning Premier League champions on penalties.
